# Built-in material maps

Colour (-a), relief/normal (-n) and roughness (-r) maps for the material catalogue (material-catalog.mts),
made by scripts/build-material-pack.cjs with the same photo-to-maps conversion the app uses for a photo
a user adds (material-maps.mts). Sources: the owner's own photographs of physical samples and swatches
from the owner's selection catalogues, plus plain-colour finishes generated by the script. Plain names only.
